```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(calibratedDML)
source("tutorial_helpers.R")
binary <- make_binary_fixture()
```

This advanced vignette documents the binary-treatment adaptive interface. The standard calibrated DML tutorials remain the default place to start.

## Calibrated R-learner mode

```{r}
fit_rlearner <- adaptive_calibrated_dml(
  data = binary$data,
  outcome = "Y",
  treatment = "A",
  covariates = c("W1", "W2"),
  control_level = 0,
  mu_mat = binary$mu_mat,
  pi_mat = binary$pi_mat,
  mode = "calibrated_rlearner",
  cate_model = "lm",
  inference = "wald"
)

summary(fit_rlearner)
```

## Plug-in mode

```{r}
fit_plugin <- adaptive_calibrated_dml(
  data = binary$data,
  outcome = "Y",
  treatment = "A",
  covariates = c("W1", "W2"),
  control_level = 0,
  mu_mat = binary$mu_mat,
  pi_mat = binary$pi_mat,
  mode = "plugin",
  inference = "wald"
)

summary(fit_plugin)
```

Adaptive DML has its own theory and practical caveats, so it is documented separately from the standard workflow tutorials.
